fusions.name: Pantry Raid
fusions.desc: Throws a quick nip that deals 4 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Door
fusions.desc: Hurls you at an enemy at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away, dealing 18 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Skirting Board
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Hall Hour
fusions.desc: At night your dodge chance rises by 12%.
